hebrewText: לִ/פְנֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֨יִם וּ/בִנְיָ֘מִ֤ן וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה עוֹרְרָ֥/ה אֶת גְּבֽוּרָתֶ֑/ךָ וּ/לְכָ֖/ה לִ/ישֻׁעָ֣תָ/ה לָּֽ/נוּ

Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
Menashsheh, a grandson of Jacob, also the tribe descended from him, and its territory

force (literally or figuratively); by implication, valor, victory

tokens.kjv: [idiom] again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, [phrase] follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, [phrase] pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, [idiom] be weak.
